newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu met representatives of the Civic Alliance, the Association of former political prisoners, and Universitary solidarity. He is to meet representatives of ethnic minorities represented in parliament later on Wednesday.
* The Chamber of Deputies lower house ended negotiations on the chairmanship and composition of standing commissions.
The National Peasant Party obtained the chairmaship of four commissions -- agriculture, health, culture and legal affairs.
The Party of Social Democracy is also to chair four commissions -- industry, human rights, defence and investigation of abuses.
The Democratic Party will lead the public administration and foreign policy commissions.
The Hungarian Democratic Union will lead the reform and privatisation commissions.
The National Liberal Party is to chair the finance and banking commission.
The National Unity Party will lead the labour and social protection commission.
The Greater Romania Party will lead the education and science commission.
* The chamber is to adopt the composition of each commission in session on Thursday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
